groups.title: Product and e-commerce
groups.brief: Product reveals, consistent packaging, readable details, and short ad formats.

groups.title: Cinematic scenes
groups.brief: Slow camera moves, continuous atmosphere, and natural environmental sound.

groups.title: Dialogue and sound
groups.brief: Two-person dialogue, timing a sound effect, and keeping ambience continuous through action.

groups.title: Miniatures and animation
groups.brief: Handmade sets, style transitions, and controlled camera reveals.

running-shoe-vertical-reveal.description: An eight-second vertical product reveal that keeps the shoe’s construction visible and reserves space for a caption.
running-shoe-vertical-reveal.alt: An unbranded teal running shoe on a concrete block

two-angle-desk-lamp.description: A short product spot that uses two photos to preserve the lamp’s appearance and a phone clip to guide the camera. The switch click lands when the light comes on.
two-angle-desk-lamp.alt: A cream desk lamp casting warm light on a wooden desk

rain-platform-departure.description: A continuous blue-hour shot with a fixed camera. The door tone, train movement, and fading hum give the clip a clear sequence.
rain-platform-departure.alt: A regional train stopped at a rain-slick platform at blue hour

tea-steam-packshot.description: A quiet product shot with controlled steam and gentle window light. The product stays fixed and the frame has room for sales copy.
tea-steam-packshot.alt: A clear glass of tea steaming next to dark packaging

paper-boat-style-transition.description: One paper boat travels through a watercolor scene and into a handmade miniature. Its direction and the sound of the water carry through the style change.
paper-boat-style-transition.alt: An orange paper boat beside a tiny bridge in a watercolor and paper landscape

miniature-bakery-finish.description: A fixed starting scene in a miniature bakery, ending on a brass counter bell. A paper bag and the bell provide two simple timed actions.
miniature-bakery-finish.alt: Miniature bread trays and a brass counter bell in a handmade bakery

ceramic-vase-listing-fidelity.description: A narrow camera orbit built around two views of the same vase. Use it to check whether the handle, rim, and glaze stay consistent across angles.
ceramic-vase-listing-fidelity.alt: A blue ceramic vase with one handle on a white gallery plinth

field-recorder-close-up.description: A short demonstration that shows a record button press, an indicator light, and a synchronized click. It reserves space for a caption.
field-recorder-close-up.alt: A matte handheld field recorder with a red indicator on a slate surface

orchard-crate-foley.description: A close shot built around one wooden thump and one rolling pear. It makes the synchronization point easy to see and hear.
orchard-crate-foley.alt: A wooden crate filled with green pears being set on an orchard packing table

ferry-ticket-hall-dialogue.description: A short, two-person exchange with a pause and a visible reaction. Both faces stay in frame for checking lip sync and speaker order.
ferry-ticket-hall-dialogue.alt: A traveler with a folded map speaking to a clerk inside a ferry terminal

ink-roller-pass.description: An overhead tabletop scene in which one roller makes a single timed pass. Its sound begins and ends with visible contact.
ink-roller-pass.alt: A printmaker moving a roller across a plate of blue ink

paper-mobile-window.description: A slow movement exercise with countable paper shapes and one quiet contact sound. An optional end frame helps set the resting angle.
paper-mobile-window.alt: Off-white pieces of a handmade paper mobile suspended beside a window

tidepool-ebb-sound.description: An image defines the rocks, a video shows the direction of the wave, and an audio reference guides the wash and its quiet bubbling tail.
tidepool-ebb-sound.alt: A shallow wave washing over slate stones and amber seaweed in a tidepool

miniature-stage-light-cue.description: A miniature theater rehearsal with a timed switch, a rising camera, and two short voice cues around the reveal.
miniature-stage-light-cue.alt: A handmade miniature stage with a pale blue curtain and a small lighting console

official_videos.title: Through Five Art Styles
official_videos.description: Follow the subject and camera through five different visual styles within a single continuous take.

official_videos.title: Into the Giant Flower World
official_videos.description: Compare the character reference sheet with the wardrobe in close-ups, low angles, and wide shots across three environments.

official_videos.title: Precision Timeline and Shot-Cut Control
official_videos.description: Watch for the entry, action, and cuts that Sand.ai directed with a written timeline.

official_videos.title: From Preview to MAGI-2
official_videos.description: Sand.ai uses a source screen recording and a text instruction to change the scene, including a cursor action and a transition.
